note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. DATAVERSE_URL must point at the Sales trial environment (trial site expires with it, about 21 Dec 2026). Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file). ./site-download holds real ids: never commit it.
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
pac auth create --environment $env:DATAVERSE_URL   # owner signs in (interactive)
if (-not $env:MGL_SITE_ID -or -not $env:MGL_MODEL_VERSION) { throw 'Set $env:MGL_SITE_ID (from pac pages list) and $env:MGL_MODEL_VERSION (1 or 2) in this shell first (owner).' }
manual_prepare: make.powerpages.microsoft.com as labadmin: create the trial site 'Contoso Retail store support' in the Sales trial environment; share the private site with alex.demo and open it once as alex.demo.
Web role Store managers on alex.demo's contact; table permissions 'Store manager cases' (Case, Contact, Read + Create) and 'Own contact' (Self, Read).
Site settings Webapi/incident/enabled, Webapi/incident/fields, Webapi/contact/enabled, Webapi/contact/fields; restart the site.
Page Support with the list, title input, button and support-api.js; browse it as alex.demo.
Episode 8 SLA still set if the Hub screen should show timers.

steps: Open the site 'Contoso Retail store support' (Edit)
Pages workspace: select the Support page; the site name is visible
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: pagekit-lint
screens.note: The wildcard edit changes only the local download copy (never uploaded) and is restored in the next command. Confirm the file name and the 'value' key from a real download (demo.md step 5). Blur ids.

screens.name: pages-table-permissions
steps: Open the site in the design studio, Security workspace, Table permissions
Open 'Store manager cases': table Case, access type Contact, relationship, privileges Read and Create, role Store managers
Open 'Own contact': Contact table, access type Self
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: pages-api-call
steps: Open the site (Preview, or its powerappsportals.com address) in a private window and sign in as alex.demo (Microsoft Entra)
Open the Support page: the case list rendered by listCases
Open browser developer tools, Network tab
Create the case 'Till offline in store 12' (High) with the button (createCase)
Select the POST to the incidents route: show the request headers (hide the token value) and the entityid response header
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: hub-portal-case
steps: Select the Sales trial environment, Apps, open Customer Service Hub (play)
Service, Cases, open 'Till offline in store 12'
Show customer = alex.demo's portal contact and the SLA timers (if the episode 8 default SLA is still set; otherwise say so)
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

manual_teardown: Delete the demo cases created from the portal (and alex.demo's contact if unneeded).
Delete the table permissions, the Store managers web role and the four Webapi site settings.
Delete the trial site (admin center, Power Pages sites).
Tear down episode 8's SLA if no longer needed.
needs: trial:Dynamics 365 Sales trial environment (ends about 21 Dec 2026)
tool:pac (Power Platform CLI, signed in by the owner)
licence:Power Pages (trial site covers the recording)
